column3: Stunned, Karen hands the laptop back to her boss. Ay-Eye Sean fires him too.
Susan reminds her. Last night, Karen threw her phone in the river... and swore to make the biggest complaint the world has ever seen.
New York is about to experience a level of complaining it never thought possible. Every borough had better prepare.
First: Martha. She's just a receptionist.
All night... All month... All year.
[drunk, shouting] Tomorrow, I'm making the complaint of the century! You hear that, Sean? Fuck you, Sean! Fuck this technology!
